desc: Windham Weaponry's .223 Superlight SRC Semi-automatic rifle features a 16" barrel (1:9 right hand twist) with Melonite QPQ finish, an A2 flash suppressor, a six position stock and manual safety lever with indicator markings on both sides of receiver. The receiver is forged aluminum and has a hardcoat black anodized finish. There are no rear or front sights but comes ready for optics or other type of accessory sights. Includes one 30-round magazine. Weight - 5.85 lbs
